name: reader-plugin
description: A local reading and learning workspace for TXT, EPUB and PDF, with notes, annotations and scoped Codex conversations.

interface.shortDescription: 阅读、思考，留下自己的笔记。
interface.longDescription: A Chinese-language reading workspace for MCP Apps hosts. Import TXT, DRM-free EPUB and PDF, organize books and notes, capture passages and page regions, and discuss them in a floating Codex conversation. Notes stay in Reader; Space handoff is optional. Floating chat requires the official Codex CLI and a signed-in account.
